alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An amber kitchen on a Sunday night. Cella, a black doorway-shaped figure with white eyes, stands in the middle with a long list stuck to her body. On the wall above her hangs the budget sheet, in monospace, reading Food: $200; a shelf holds seven identical lidded boxes in a row; a phone leans on the floor showing a chef hat and a full level bar. Two closed doors flank her: a low wooden door on the left and a wide, padded red door on the right. Text: I planned 7 flawless dinners. Both doors open. Through the wooden one: a cold stove with a pan, a cutting board with an untouched tomato and onion. Through the red one: a warm paper bag and a coffee cup peek out. Cella looks at the wooden door, back to the padded one, leans toward it and rests her body on the phone. Text: I'm too brilliant to chop tonight. A wall calendar flips its pages quickly, and with every page one more paper bag lands in a tidy block of five rows of five beside the red door: 25. A long receipt slides out of the phone and sticks to Cella, who looks at it sideways: Month: $410, below the sheet that says Food: $200. Text: Takeout this week?
envio: the friend whose Sunday meal prep ends in takeout
